question: In what ways is the Mālinī, the totality of sound, divided?
premises: Mālinī is identified as the mass of sound.
It can be taken as collected and as separated, giving a twofold division.
Alternatively, as a single heroic power or through paired union, it forms a sixfold grouping.
inference: Mālinī is divided twofold as collected and separated, and alternatively appears as a sixfold grouping through single-hero or paired-union modes.
uncertainties: The precise referents of the sixfold grouping are not enumerated in this verse.
plain_english: Mālinī, the mass of sound, is twofold as collected and separated. Or else, by its single-hero state or through paired union, it is taken as a sixfold group.
